content.introduction: According to Earnings Whispers, Micron Technology (MU) reported earnings of $33.42 per share on revenue of $54.23 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 2026, missing the consensus earnings estimate of $31.41 per share on revenue of $50.86 billion. Meanwhile, Zscaler (ZS) beat expectations by 5.31% with earnings of $1.19 per share on revenue of $898.19 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 2026. Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) is expected to report earnings on October 28, 2026, with a consensus earnings estimate of $6.39 per share. The sources don't provide a definitive answer on the earnings whisper number for META.
